rollups.text: Abstract-expressionism interest: In April 2023, the user visited their local Modern Art Museum and spent about 20 minutes looking at an unidentified Jackson Pollock artwork; by May 20, 2023, they wanted to learn more about abstract expressionism and asked for artist biographies, documentaries, and resources on the movement’s history and development. The user also reported visiting the museum on a Saturday, March 12, but the year is unspecified.

Homemade yogurt: On May 20, 2023, the user said they had figured out the yogurt-making function on their Instant Pot and had begun making plain yogurt. They wanted to control ingredients and reduce added sugar, considered vanilla or cinnamon and a little honey or maple syrup, and hoped to try yogurt made from non-dairy milks including almond, soy, coconut, oat, and cashew.

Sleep routine: On May 23, 2023, the user said weekends made it difficult to stick to a bedtime routine and asked how to use a guided meditation app for sleep. They had used the app after waking during the night but sometimes struggled to fall asleep again, and asked for further strategies. They were interested in lavender and vanilla essential-oil scents and planned to get a diffuser and lavender oil.

Summer cocktail planning: On May 22, 2023, the user was planning a summer dinner party and wanted a refreshing gin cocktail using garden herbs, especially lavender. A lavender gin fizz made the preceding weekend did not turn out as expected after the user substituted honey and water for the called-for lavender syrup; the user clarified they had not infused the gin with lavender. They planned to make simple syrup and experiment with gin brands. They had Bombay Sapphire as their go-to gin for gin and tonics and were enjoying Fever-Tree elderflower tonic; they planned to try lavender syrup or infusion with these.

Mother’s Day necklace: On May 23, 2023, the user planned an elegant silver necklace with a small pendant for their mother, with a budget of about $250, inspired by a similar Tiffany & Co. necklace the user had bought for their sister’s birthday on February 15 (year unspecified). The sister loved that necklace, which cost around $250. The user decided to look at Tiffany & Co.’s current collection and hoped a sale or promotion would keep the mother’s gift within budget.

Meal planning: On May 24, 2023, the user wanted to improve meal planning, reduce food waste, and prepare healthy meals and snacks on weekends, especially Sundays, for workdays. They liked make-ahead scrambled egg muffins, energy balls and trail mix, and wanted more exciting lunches than relying on the office deli; dinner leftovers were one possible approach. They also wanted healthy home-cooked dinners using pantry ingredients and liked one-pot pasta with vegetables. On May 28, they described making a large quinoa salad with roasted vegetables and citrus vinaigrette every Sunday for weekday lunches, varying the citrus and favoring lemon, lime, and orange together.

Skincare: On May 25, 2023, the user asked about sunscreen for sensitive skin, reapplication, sunburn, mixing products, and recognizing reactions. On May 26, they said a Drunk Elephant skincare set bought at Sephora had improved their skin, but they were unsure how often to use it; they used a Drunk Elephant serum at night and a physical exfoliant once a week and asked whether to use the serum in the morning and whether weekly exfoliation was sufficient. They had also found a new, unnamed facial moisturizer brand at Target and were open to trying others.

Workday routine and habit changes: On May 28, 2023, the user said they usually woke at 7:00 a.m. but since the April 2023 daylight-saving-time change struggled to get up before 7:30; they arrived at work by 8:30, handled urgent emails and priority tasks, and felt sluggish around 3:00 p.m. A Friday team meeting was at 2:00 p.m. After a productivity seminar a couple of weeks earlier, they liked the idea of focused 90-minute blocks and morning priority work. They wanted to reduce coffee and try nuts and seeds, fresh fruit, and protein snack balls, and planned to schedule meditation, exercise, and snacks, start with one or two changes, celebrate small wins, and use a habit tracker. They asked for tracker recommendations but did not choose one.

Sequoia National Park trip planning: On May 28, 2023, the user was planning a trip and wanted day-hike recommendations. They had experience with long drives and national-park hiking, including a road trip to Yosemite National Park where they stayed two nights at Yosemite Valley Lodge. They asked about the Congress Trail’s surface, restrooms, water, crowd avoidance around the General Sherman Tree, parking and shuttle options, and picnic rules. They also considered bringing a camera to photograph giant sequoias. The trip itself was an idea, not a confirmed visit.

Chicago graduation trip: By May 30, 2023, the user was planning to travel to Chicago in June to attend the law school graduation of a friend’s sister. The ceremony was scheduled for a Saturday at 2 p.m. at the Auditorium Theatre in the Loop, but the exact date was not provided. The user planned to attend the full ceremony, preferred to fly into O’Hare, hoped to arrive one or two days early, and wanted a hotel near the venue. Their hoped-for budget was $200–$300 round trip for airfare and $100–$150 per hotel night. They considered brunch at The Gage or Roanoke and asked for post-ceremony dinner recommendations; no bookings or restaurant choices were reported.

Family visit photo album: Emma, the user’s sister, visited sometime from May 22 through May 28, 2023; they enjoyed themselves, went to dinner several times including the user’s favorite Italian restaurant Bella Vita, and visited a zoo where Emma loved the giraffes. On May 30, the user planned to organize family-brunch photos and make a shared album, chose Google Photos because they already used it, selected the title “Emma’s Visit 2023,” and planned to add notes to the photos.

rollups.text: Community volunteering: On May 30, 2023, the user said the Youth Development organization’s website showed it partnered with the user’s local high school to provide after-school programs. The user emailed the organization about volunteering and received a reply that opportunities were coming up. The user was excited to volunteer and give back; no specific opportunity or start date was established.

Mental-health awareness campaign: By May 30, 2023, the user had participated in a social-media mental-health awareness campaign that received more than 200 stories and uses of its hashtag. They were considering a new campaign to promote a local mental-health support group, including an Instagram Reels series called “Mental Health Monday” about their own experiences with anxiety and depression and coping. They valued community, relatability, diverse perspectives, and helping people feel less alone and encouraged to seek support, and considered collaborating with other advocates or influencers. The new campaign remained under consideration.

Dance and cultural learning: On May 30, 2023, the user said they had danced for a while, taken a break of a few years, and recently returned to classes at a local studio. They were seeking Afrobeat and house dance studios, enjoyed Afrobeat’s energy and the challenge of learning rhythms, and were learning Ghanaian Azonto, practicing the Azonto bump, hip isolations, and independent arm-and-leg polyrhythms. They had listened to Fela Kuti and planned to explore other artists. They had not yet performed with a group but were excited about a studio instructor’s planned cultural-festival performance. They wanted to learn more about Azonto’s cultural context and other African dance styles.

Items the user said they owned and were considering selling, all reported May 26, 2023: 1960s-era Fender Jazzmaster guitar; first edition of Harper Lee’s To Kill a Mockingbird; 1960s Batman action figure; vintage 1960s Omega Seamaster watch; limited-edition Tag Heuer Carrera; 1980s-era Sony Walkman Professional; rare first edition of The Avengers #1 (1963); and a 1950s Cuban peso banknote, which the user thought might be worth a few hundred dollars. The user asked about selling platforms and, for The Avengers #1, grading and certification.

Necklace gifts: On February 15 (year unspecified), the user gave their sister a Tiffany & Co. silver necklace with a small pendant for her birthday; it cost around $250 and she loved it. On May 29, 2023, the user said they had given their sister a silver necklace with a small pendant from Zara for her 25th birthday; it cost $40. On May 23, the user was considering a similar elegant silver pendant necklace for their mother, with a target budget near $250. On May 29, the user planned to look on Etsy for a personalized necklace for a friend’s birthday, similar in style to the Zara necklace, hoping for delivery within a week.
The user reported visiting the new H&M store at the mall three times by May 26, 2023. The store had opened in April 2023; the user liked its trendy clothes and affordable prices.
On May 30, 2023, the user said the earlier social-media mental-health awareness campaign had received stories and hashtag use from more than 200 people.
